{{Infobox auto}}
'''Fish bones''' are a [[fishing junk]] item. They are a {{MCW|Bone|bone}} with a different name and texture, so they work anywhere a bone does, for example crafting [[Bone Meal|bone meal]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Fishing ===
* The junk table lists them at 10 of 78 weight in most biomes (12.82% of junk, about 1.28% of all catches in open water). These come from the loot table <code>matcha:materials/fish_bones</code>.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/junk.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fish_bones.json}}</ref>
* 90.91% of the Sulfur Caves table, 77.27% of catches in open water in Sulfur Caves (plus those from the junk table).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/sulfur_caves.json}}</ref>

Catching fish bones plays their own [[fishing sounds|sound]] and unlocks the Fish Bones entry of the [[Angler's Almanac]]. Fish bones from the junk table carry a <code>custom_data</code> tag (<code>version: 1</code>) that those from Sulfur Caves lack, so the two don't stack with each other.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/sulfur_caves.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fish_bones.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/fishing_sounds/fish_bones.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/anglers_almanac/junk/fish_bones.json}}</ref> In 1.12.6-alpha and 1.12.7-beta the [[Updating items|item updater]] added the tag to any bone held in either hand, including plain bones; since {{Version|1.12.8-beta}} its only remaining check looks for an item name that no item has, so plain bones and Sulfur Caves fish bones stay as they are.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/advancement/trigger/fish_bones.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.3|Fish bones from Sulfur Caves now have the correct texture, so they stack with fish bones from the junk table.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/sulfur_caves.json}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.4|2=Junk fish bones come from their own loot table, <code>matcha:materials/fish_bones</code>. That table gives an {{MCW|Ender Pearl|ender pearl}} with the fish bones name and model instead of a bone (see [[Known bugs]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fish_bones.json|at=acec32328368f3985c45f8077732d92a664f3d13}}</ref> The junk table couldn't be loaded, so they could only be caught in Sulfur Caves.}}
{{History line|1.12.5|The junk table loads again, so fish bones can be caught as junk, as ender pearls.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.5|quote=Fishing Junk LT Fixed (Not for modded biomes)}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.6-alpha|Junk fish bones are bones instead of ender pearls, so they work as a bone, play their catch sound and unlock their Angler's Almanac entry.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/materials/fish_bones.json}}</ref> The item updater turns any held bone without its version tag into fish bones.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/advancement/trigger/fish_bones.json|at=fe225857ed8af507b7f5755f4d41678f6862b1bd}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.7-beta|Fishing junk became much more common (62.5% of open-water catches), so fish bones were caught far more often.}}
{{History line|1.12.8-beta|date=October 23, 2026|The item updater no longer turns plain bones into fish bones. Junk is back to 10% of open-water catches.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/predicate/mainhand/fish_bones.json}}</ref>}}
}}
